purpose: Human/model-assisted semantic review corrections to the first-pass GEIPAN CE classifier. Apply after automated classification and before final release validation.
rule: Encounter class describes reported event content, independent of GEIPAN A/B/C/D identification outcome. Highest applicable public class wins.

1973-01-02356.basis: reported ground at the object's stationary location was burned/blackened

1976-04-00300.basis: reported television disturbances in the area contemporaneous with the luminous event

1976-10-00353.basis: reported television interference contemporaneous with the encounter

1977-12-00468.basis: television interference was reported at the same hours as the repeated object observations

1978-10-00550.basis: moped stopped functioning during the close object observation and worked again after the object departed

1979-11-00683.basis: sheep approximately 600 m away reportedly became highly agitated during the encounter

1980-03-00745.basis: reported electrical event included an apparent ground strike/arc and a voltage drop observed by multiple people
